blurb: American Dance Academy provides dance classes for various ages and skill levels, including toddler classes with caregiver participation, beginner to advanced ballet, jazz, tap, hip hop, pom, contemporary, baton twirling, acro dance, and a specialized Rhythm Works Integrative Dance program for students with special needs. Classes focus on technique, coordination, and performance skills, culminating in annual recitals and bi-annual holiday shows.
